description: This file defines the IReminderRegistry interface for managing grain reminders in Orleans, including methods for registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders.

classes.name: IReminderRegistry
classes.description: Interface for managing reminders within Orleans grains, providing methods to register, unregister, and retrieve reminders.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers or updates a reminder with a specified name for the current grain, returning the reminder object.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Unregisters a specified reminder from the current grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name for the current grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders registered to the current grain.
